title: Rainforest Explorer A-Z
hook: Good explorer eyes can wait before they name.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one-beat cue gap with soft backing
visualStyle: friendly 3D rainforest explorer storybook, simple trail markers, leaf green and sun gold, uncluttered educational composition

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a careful child observer solving visual clues from a fixed respectful distance
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: slow the search into glimpse-shape-name rather than speed spotting
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: walking 4/4 with suspense rests before reveals
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written clue-first observations with varied syntax; dangerous or shy wildlife is never approached for a better view
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: visual clue -> recall beat -> target reveal -> safe pointing/framing gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: soft marimba droplets and hand-percussion answers, never masking words
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Turn rainforest exploration into a visual mystery: partial silhouettes, color patches, leaf movement and texture clues appear before the full target, teaching careful noticing rather than frantic spotting.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child uses binocular-like framing; recurring language uses edge, glimpse, patch, shape, behind, reveal, still, closer-with-eyes and not-with-feet.
semanticArc: harder camouflage and distance clues appear
final reveals teach patience over chasing
forbiddenGenericLanguage: explorer eyes come look with me
find the jungle clues with me
